decision.observation: Clear frame: a long metal pipe runs along the gate's top rail through a bracket at the right post, ending in a hanging elbow on the dark mound at the post's base (~0.65, 0.72) — this pipe is the sliding latch pin. Earlier a pre-aligned left-press drag visibly moved this pipe.
decision.hypothesis: Grabbing the hanging pipe end (pre-aligned press at its position) and dragging the pointer left will slide the pipe out of the right-post bracket, freeing the gate to swing open.
decision.memory: Technique that moved the pipe: pointer exactly on it, hold left, move pointer. Apply with a larger leftward pull.
